-- A tokenizer and recursive-descent parser for arithmetic, with variables and errors.

local function tokenize(source)
	local tokens = {}
	local i = 1
	while i <= #source do
		local c = source:sub(i, i)
		if c:match("%s") then
			i += 1
		elseif c:match("%d") then
			local number = source:match("^%d+%.?%d*", i)
			table.insert(tokens, { kind = "number", value = tonumber(number) })
			i += #number
		elseif c:match("[%a_]") then
			local name = source:match("^[%a_][%w_]*", i)
			table.insert(tokens, { kind = "name", value = name })
			i += #name
		elseif c:match("[%+%-%*/%^%(%)=]") then
			table.insert(tokens, { kind = c })
			i += 1
		else
			error(`unexpected character '{c}' at {i}`, 0)
		end
	end
	table.insert(tokens, { kind = "end" })
	return tokens
end

local Parser = {}
Parser.__index = Parser

function Parser.new(tokens, variables)
	return setmetatable({ tokens = tokens, pos = 1, variables = variables }, Parser)
end

function Parser:peek()
	return self.tokens[self.pos].kind
end

function Parser:take(kind)
	local token = self.tokens[self.pos]
	if kind and token.kind ~= kind then
		error(`expected {kind}, got {token.kind}`, 0)
	end
	self.pos += 1
	return token
end

local PRECEDENCE = { ["+"] = 1, ["-"] = 1, ["*"] = 2, ["/"] = 2, ["^"] = 3 }

function Parser:primary()
	local token = self:take()
	if token.kind == "number" then
		return token.value
	elseif token.kind == "name" then
		local value = self.variables[token.value]
		if value == nil then
			error(`unknown variable {token.value}`, 0)
		end
		return value
	elseif token.kind == "-" then
		return -self:expression(3)
	elseif token.kind == "(" then
		local value = self:expression(0)
		self:take(")")
		return value
	end
	error(`unexpected {token.kind}`, 0)
end

function Parser:expression(minimum)
	local left = self:primary()
	while true do
		local op = self:peek()
		local precedence = PRECEDENCE[op]
		if not precedence or precedence <= minimum and op ~= "^" or precedence < minimum then
			return left
		end
		self:take()
		local right = self:expression(op == "^" and precedence - 1 or precedence)
		if op == "+" then
			left += right
		elseif op == "-" then
			left -= right
		elseif op == "*" then
			left *= right
		elseif op == "/" then
			if right == 0 then
				error("division by zero", 0)
			end
			left /= right
		else
			left ^= right
		end
	end
end

local function run(line, variables)
	local tokens = tokenize(line)
	local target
	if tokens[2].kind == "=" then
		target = tokens[1].value
		table.remove(tokens, 1)
		table.remove(tokens, 1)
	end
	local parser = Parser.new(tokens, variables)
	local value = parser:expression(0)
	parser:take("end")
	if target then
		variables[target] = value
	end
	return value
end

local variables = { pi = math.pi }
for _, line in { "x = 2 + 3 * 4", "y = (x - 4) ^ 2 / 2", "x * y - -3", "r = 2", "pi * r ^ 2", "1 / (x - 14)", "z + 1", "3 $ 4" } do
	local ok, result = pcall(run, line, variables)
	print(line, "=>", if ok then string.format("%.4g", result) else `error: {result}`)
end

-- generic for without an iterator function: plain tables (array part, then hash part), __iter
-- returning a closure or next, objects with __call, coroutines, and pairs and ipairs, which the
-- compiler turns into their own loop instructions
local function keys(t)
	local out = {}
	for k in t do
		table.insert(out, tostring(k))
	end
	table.sort(out)
	return table.concat(out, ",")
end

local list = { "a", "b", "c" }
for i, v in list do
	print("plain", i, v)
end
for i, v in ipairs(list) do
	print("ipairs", i, v)
end
for i, v in pairs(list) do
	print("pairs", i, v)
end
print(keys({ x = 1, y = 2, [3] = true, [true] = 0 }))

-- a hole: ipairs stops at it, a plain loop and pairs walk past it
local holes = { 1, 2, nil, 4 }
local viaIpairs, viaPlain, viaPairs = 0, 0, 0
for _ in ipairs(holes) do
	viaIpairs += 1
end
for _ in holes do
	viaPlain += 1
end
for _ in pairs(holes) do
	viaPairs += 1
end
print(viaIpairs, viaPlain, viaPairs)

-- __iter returning a stateful closure
local Range = {}
Range.__index = Range
Range.__iter = function(self)
	local i = self.from - self.step
	return function()
		i += self.step
		if i <= self.to then
			return i, i * i
		end
		return nil
	end
end
local function range(from, to, step)
	return setmetatable({ from = from, to = to, step = step or 1 }, Range)
end
for v, sq in range(1, 7, 3) do
	print("range", v, sq)
end

-- __iter handing back next and another table to walk
local Bag = {
	__iter = function(self)
		return next, self.items
	end,
}
local bag = setmetatable({ items = { "x", "y" }, hidden = true }, Bag)
for k, v in bag do
	print("bag", k, v)
end

-- an object with __call is the iterator function itself
local countdown = setmetatable({ n = 3 }, {
	__call = function(self)
		if self.n > 0 then
			self.n -= 1
			return self.n + 1
		end
		return nil
	end,
})
for v in countdown do
	print("countdown", v)
end

-- a coroutine as the iterator
for v in coroutine.wrap(function()
	for i = 1, 3 do
		coroutine.yield(i * 2)
	end
end) do
	print("co", v)
end

-- continue, break and writing the loop variable inside generalized loops
for i, v in list do
	if v == "b" then
		continue
	end
	i *= 10
	print("skip b", i, v)
end
local found
for i, v in { 5, 6, 7, 8 } do
	if v % 2 == 1 and i > 1 then
		found = i
		break
	end
end
print("found", found)

-- nested loops over the same table, the inner one reading the outer's variables
local grid = { { 1, 2 }, { 3, 4 } }
local sum = 0
for r, row in grid do
	for c, cell in row do
		sum += cell * r * c
	end
end
print("grid", sum)

-- a table changed between loops is walked as it is now
local growing = { 1 }
for round = 1, 3 do
	local seen = 0
	for _ in growing do
		seen += 1
	end
	growing[#growing + 1] = round
	print("round", round, seen)
end

-- for loops: generic for over custom iterators (stateless, stateful, next directly), numeric for
-- with float and negative steps, bounds evaluated once, and a body that writes its loop variable
local function range(n)
	local i = 0
	return function()
		i += 1
		if i <= n then
			return i, i * i
		end
	end
end
for i, sq in range(3) do
	print("range", i, sq)
end

local function evens(t, i)
	i += 2
	if t[i] ~= nil then
		return i, t[i]
	end
end
local list = { "a", "b", "c", "d", "e" }
for i, v in evens, list, -1 do
	print("evens", i, v)
end

local sorted = { 10, 20, 30 }
for i, v in next, sorted do
	print("next", i, v)
end
for i, v in ipairs({ 1, 2, nil, 4 }) do
	print("ipairs", i, v)
end

for i = 1, 2, 0.5 do
	print("float", i)
end
for i = 3, 1, -1 do
	print("down", i)
end
for i = 1, 0 do
	print("never", i)
end
for i = 1.0, 3 do
	print("float start", i)
end

local calls = 0
local function bound(v)
	calls += 1
	return v
end
for i = bound(1), bound(3), bound(1) do
	print("bounded", i)
end
print("bound calls", calls)

-- writing the loop variable changes only this iteration's copy
for i = 1, 3 do
	local before = i
	i = i * 10
	print("copy", before, i)
end

-- a while loop with two exits and a repeat that runs once
local n, steps = 27, 0
while true do
	if n == 1 then
		break
	end
	if steps > 200 then
		print("too long")
		break
	end
	n = if n % 2 == 0 then n // 2 else 3 * n + 1
	steps += 1
end
print("collatz", steps)
repeat
	steps -= 1
until true
print("after repeat", steps)

-- nested loops where the inner break and continue only touch the inner loop
local found = {}
for i = 1, 4 do
	for j = 1, 4 do
		if j > i then
			break
		end
		if (i + j) % 2 == 1 then
			continue
		end
		found[#found + 1] = i * 10 + j
	end
end
print(table.concat(found, " "))

		local e = Entry.get()[id]

		end

-- A* on a small grid map, with a binary heap for the open set.

local MAP = {
	"S....#....",
	".##..#.##.",
	".#...#..#.",
	".#.###..#.",
	"...#....#G",
	"##.#.####.",
	"..........",
}

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}
		for x = 1, #row do
			local c = row:sub(x, x)
			grid[y][x] = c ~= "#"
			if c == "S" then
				start = { x = x, y = y }
			elseif c == "G" then
				goal = { x = x, y = y }
			end
		end
	end
	return grid, start, goal
end

local function key(x, y)
	return y * 1000 + x
end

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)
end

local Heap = {}
Heap.__index = Heap

function Heap.new()
	return setmetatable({ items = {}, size = 0 }, Heap)
end

function Heap:push(node, priority)
	self.size += 1
	local i = self.size
	self.items[i] = { node = node, priority = priority }
	while i > 1 do
		local parent = i // 2
		if self.items[parent].priority <= self.items[i].priority then
			break
		end
		self.items[parent], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[parent]
		i = parent
	end
end

function Heap:pop()
	if self.size == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local top = self.items[1]
	self.items[1] = self.items[self.size]
	self.items[self.size] = nil
	self.size -= 1
	local i = 1
	while true do
		local smallest, left, right = i, i * 2, i * 2 + 1
		if left <= self.size and self.items[left].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = left
		end
		if right <= self.size and self.items[right].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = right
		end
		if smallest == i then
			break
		end
		self.items[smallest], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[smallest]
		i = smallest
	end
	return top.node
end

local DIRECTIONS = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }

local function findPath(grid, start, goal)
	local open = Heap.new()
	local cameFrom, cost = {}, { [key(start.x, start.y)] = 0 }
	open:push(start, heuristic(start, goal))
	local visited = 0
	while open.size > 0 do
		local current = open:pop()
		visited += 1
		if current.x == goal.x and current.y == goal.y then
			local path = { current }
			local k = key(current.x, current.y)
			while cameFrom[k] do
				current = cameFrom[k]
				table.insert(path, 1, current)
				k = key(current.x, current.y)
			end
			return path, visited
		end
		for _, d in DIRECTIONS do
			local nx, ny = current.x + d[1], current.y + d[2]
			if not (grid[ny] and grid[ny][nx]) then
				continue
			end
			local nk = key(nx, ny)
			local newCost = cost[key(current.x, current.y)] + 1
			if cost[nk] == nil or newCost < cost[nk] then
				cost[nk] = newCost
				cameFrom[nk] = current
				local next = { x = nx, y = ny }
				open:push(next, newCost + heuristic(next, goal))
			end
		end
	end
	return nil, visited
end

local grid, start, goal = parse(MAP)
local path, visited = findPath(grid, start, goal)
if path then
	local steps = {}
	for i, p in path do
		steps[i] = `({p.x},{p.y})`
	end
	print(`found a path of {#path - 1} steps after visiting {visited} cells`)
	print(table.concat(steps, " "))
else
	print("no path")
end

-- locals that are written inside a loop and read after it, or in a repeat's condition
do
	local function scan(s)
		local depth, out = 0, {}
		local i = 1
		while i <= #s do
			local c = string.sub(s, i, i)
			if c == "(" then
				depth += 1
			elseif c == ")" then
				depth -= 1
				if depth < 0 then
					return "unbalanced at " .. i
				end
			elseif c == "x" and depth == 0 then
				table.insert(out, i)
			else
				i += 1
				continue
			end
			i += 1
		end
		if depth ~= 0 then
			return "open"
		end
		return table.concat(out, ",")
	end
	print(scan("x(x)x"), scan("(()"), scan("())x"), scan(""))
end
do
	local fs = {}
	local i = 0
	repeat
		i += 1
		local x = i * 3
		table.insert(fs, function() return x end)
	until x > 10
	local r = {}
	for _, f in fs do table.insert(r, f()) end
	print(table.concat(r, ","))
	local function g(t)
		local n = 0
		repeat
			n += 1
			local v = t[n]
		until v == nil or v < 0
		return n
	end
	print(g({1, 2, -1, 5}), g({}))
end

local function track(t, name)
	return setmetatable({}, {
		__index = t,
		__newindex = function(_, k, v)
			table.insert(log, name .. "." .. tostring(k))
			rawset(t, k, v)
		end,
	})
end

-- vectors: vector.create with constant arguments folds into a vector constant, which has to come
-- back as something vanilla Luau runs (Roblox spells it Vector3.new, plain Luau doesn't have
-- that), plus vector arithmetic, components and the vector library, which compile to fast calls
local function show(v)
	return string.format("%g,%g,%g", v.x, v.y, v.z)
end

local up = vector.create(0, 1, 0)
local unit = vector.create(1, 1, 1)
print(show(up), show(unit), typeof(up), up == vector.create(0, 1, 0))
print(show(vector.create(-0, 0.5, 1e300)), show(vector.create(1 / 3, 2 ^ 20, -7)))

-- arithmetic with vectors and numbers, and unary minus
local a, b = vector.create(1, 2, 3), vector.create(4, 5, 6)
print(show(a + b), show(a - b), show(a * b), show(b / a), show(a * 2), show(3 / b), show(-a), show(b // a))

-- components, and arguments known only at run time
local n = #"abcd"
local v = vector.create(n, n * 2, n // 3)
print(v.x, v.y, v.z, v.X, v.Y, v.Z)

-- the vector library
print(vector.magnitude(vector.create(3, 4, 0)), show(vector.normalize(vector.create(0, 0, 9))))
print(vector.dot(a, b), show(vector.cross(a, b)), show(vector.floor(vector.create(1.5, -1.5, 2))))
print(show(vector.ceil(vector.create(1.2, -1.2, 0))), show(vector.abs(vector.create(-1, 2, -3))))
print(show(vector.sign(vector.create(-5, 0, 5))), show(vector.clamp(vector.create(5, -5, 0), vector.zero, vector.one)))
print(show(vector.max(a, b, vector.create(9, 0, 0))), show(vector.min(a, b)), vector.angle(vector.create(1, 0, 0), up))
print(show(vector.zero), show(vector.one))

-- vectors as table keys and in comparisons
local seen = {}
seen[vector.create(1, 2, 3)] = "found"
print(seen[a], a == vector.create(1, 2, 3), a ~= b)

-- rosetta mutant mut1-13 of pathfinding: print, wrap do, wrap repeat
-- A* on a small grid map, with a binary heap for the open set.

local MAP = {
	"S....#....",
	".##..#.##.",
	".#...#..#.",
	".#.###..#.",
	"...#....#G",
	"##.#.####.",
	"..........",
}

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}
		for x = 1, #row do
			local c = row:sub(x, x)
			grid[y][x] = c ~= "#"
			if c == "S" then
				start = { x = x, y = y }
			elseif c == "G" then
				goal = { x = x, y = y }
			end
		end
	end
	return grid, start, goal
end

local function key(x, y)
	return y * 1000 + x
end

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)
end

local Heap = {}
Heap.__index = Heap

function Heap.new()
	return setmetatable({ items = {}, size = 0 }, Heap)
end

function Heap:push(node, priority)
print("m68421", goal)
	self.size += 1
	local i = self.size
	self.items[i] = { node = node, priority = priority }
	while i > 1 do
		local parent = i // 2
		if self.items[parent].priority <= self.items[i].priority then
			break
		end
		self.items[parent], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[parent]
		i = parent
	end
end

function Heap:pop()
	if self.size == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local top = self.items[1]
	self.items[1] = self.items[self.size]
	self.items[self.size] = nil
repeat
do
	self.size -= 1
end
until true
	local i = 1
	while true do
		local smallest, left, right = i, i * 2, i * 2 + 1
		if left <= self.size and self.items[left].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = left
		end
		if right <= self.size and self.items[right].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = right
		end
		if smallest == i then
			break
		end
		self.items[smallest], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[smallest]
		i = smallest
	end
	return top.node
end

local DIRECTIONS = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }

local function findPath(grid, start, goal)
	local open = Heap.new()
	local cameFrom, cost = {}, { [key(start.x, start.y)] = 0 }
	open:push(start, heuristic(start, goal))
	local visited = 0
	while open.size > 0 do
		local current = open:pop()
		visited += 1
		if current.x == goal.x and current.y == goal.y then
			local path = { current }
			local k = key(current.x, current.y)
			while cameFrom[k] do
				current = cameFrom[k]
				table.insert(path, 1, current)
				k = key(current.x, current.y)
			end
			return path, visited
		end
		for _, d in DIRECTIONS do
			local nx, ny = current.x + d[1], current.y + d[2]
			if not (grid[ny] and grid[ny][nx]) then
				continue
			end
			local nk = key(nx, ny)
			local newCost = cost[key(current.x, current.y)] + 1
			if cost[nk] == nil or newCost < cost[nk] then
				cost[nk] = newCost
				cameFrom[nk] = current
				local next = { x = nx, y = ny }
				open:push(next, newCost + heuristic(next, goal))
			end
		end
	end
	return nil, visited
end

local grid, start, goal = parse(MAP)
local path, visited = findPath(grid, start, goal)
if path then
	local steps = {}
	for i, p in path do
		steps[i] = `({p.x},{p.y})`
	end
	print(`found a path of {#path - 1} steps after visiting {visited} cells`)
	print(table.concat(steps, " "))
else
	print("no path")
end

-- rosetta mutant mut1-14 of nested_inlining: wrap closure
-- shapes from inlined helpers with control flow (-O2 copies them into their callers)

local flags = { force = false, edge = true }
local layers = { get = function(_, key) return { fromEdge = key == "edge" } end }
local urls = {}
urls.delivery = "https://delivery/"
urls.plain = "https://plain/"

-- early returns, one inside a condition with a call in it, inlined into an argument
local function resolveHost()
	if flags.force then
		return urls.delivery
	end
	if flags.edge then
		local data = layers:get("edge")
		if data and data.fromEdge then
			return urls.delivery
		end
	end
	return urls.plain
end
local function fetchIcons(ids)
	return string.format("%sicons?ids=%s", resolveHost(), table.concat(ids, ","))
end
print(fetchIcons({ 1, 2 }))
flags.edge = false
print(fetchIcons({ 3 }))

-- a return from inside a loop
local function hasName(names, name)
	if type(names) == "table" then
		for _, n in names do
			if n == name then
				return true
			end
		end
	elseif type(names) == "string" then
		return names == name
	end
	return false
end
local function matches(schema, value)
	if schema.kind ~= value.kind or schema.name ~= nil and not hasName(schema.name, value.name) then
		return "no"
	end
	return "yes"
end
print(matches({ kind = 1, name = { "a", "b" } }, { kind = 1, name = "b" }), matches({ kind = 1, name = "x" }, { kind = 1, name = "y" }))

-- `return a and b and f()`, with f returning early
local vr = false
local function supported()
	if vr then
		return flags.force
	end
	return true
end
local _ = (function()
local function enabled(a, b)
	return a and b and supported()
end
print(enabled(true, true), enabled(true, false))
end)()
vr = true
print(enabled(true, true))

-- a helper inlined into one that is inlined in turn, returning from a loop
local function escape(s)
	if s == "" then
		return "%00"
	end
	return (s:gsub("%.", "%%2E"))
end
local function segmentFor(node, known)
	if node.parent ~= nil then
		for _, entry in known do
			if entry.node == node then
				return entry.segment
			end
		end
	end
	return escape(node.name)
end
local function pathOf(node, known)
	local parts = {}
	while node do
		table.insert(parts, 1, segmentFor(node, known))
		node = node.parent
	end
	return table.concat(parts, "/")
end
local root = { name = "" }
local mid = { name = "a.b", parent = root }
local leaf = { name = "c", parent = mid }
print(pathOf(leaf, { { node = mid, segment = "M" } }), pathOf(leaf, {}))

-- a helper whose returns all lead to its caller's end
local picks, misses = {}, 0
local function pick(x)
	local hit = if x > 2 then x * 10 else nil
	if hit ~= nil then
		table.insert(picks, hit)
		return
	end
	if x < 0 then
		misses += 1
	end
end
local function onInput(kind, x, blocked)
	if kind == "click" then
		if not blocked then
			pick(x)
		end
	elseif kind == "touch" then
		misses += 100
	end
end
onInput("click", 5, false)
onInput("click", -1, false)
onInput("click", 9, true)
onInput("touch", 0, false)
print(table.concat(picks, ","), misses)

-- `continue` in a `repeat` goes to its condition
local function walk(list)
	local out, i, stack = {}, 0, list
	repeat
		i += 1
		local v = stack[i]
		if v == nil or v == false then
			continue
		end
		table.insert(out, v)
	until i >= #stack
	return table.concat(out, ",")
end

	end
until stop

-- rosetta mutant mut1-35 of calculator: flip, wrap do
-- A tokenizer and recursive-descent parser for arithmetic, with variables and errors.

local function tokenize(source)
	local tokens = {}
	local i = 1
	while i  <  #source do
		local c = source:sub(i, i)
		if c:match("%s") then
			i += 1
		elseif c:match("%d") then
			local number = source:match("^%d+%.?%d*", i)
			table.insert(tokens, { kind = "number", value = tonumber(number) })
			i += #number
		elseif c:match("[%a_]") then
			local name = source:match("^[%a_][%w_]*", i)
			table.insert(tokens, { kind = "name", value = name })
			i += #name
		elseif c:match("[%+%-%*/%^%(%)=]") then
			table.insert(tokens, { kind = c })
			i += 1
		else
			error(`unexpected character '{c}' at {i}`, 0)
		end
	end
	table.insert(tokens, { kind = "end" })
	return tokens
end

local Parser = {}
Parser.__index = Parser

function Parser.new(tokens, variables)
	return setmetatable({ tokens = tokens, pos = 1, variables = variables }, Parser)
end

function Parser:peek()
	return self.tokens[self.pos].kind
end

function Parser:take(kind)
	local token = self.tokens[self.pos]
	if kind and token.kind ~= kind then
		error(`expected {kind}, got {token.kind}`, 0)
	end
	self.pos += 1
do
	return token
end
end

local PRECEDENCE = { ["+"] = 1, ["-"] = 1, ["*"] = 2, ["/"] = 2, ["^"] = 3 }

function Parser:primary()
	local token = self:take()
	if token.kind == "number" then
		return token.value
	elseif token.kind == "name" then
		local value = self.variables[token.value]
		if value == nil then
			error(`unknown variable {token.value}`, 0)
		end
		return value
	elseif token.kind == "-" then
		return -self:expression(3)
	elseif token.kind == "(" then
		local value = self:expression(0)
		self:take(")")
		return value
	end
	error(`unexpected {token.kind}`, 0)
end

function Parser:expression(minimum)
	local left = self:primary()
	while true do
		local op = self:peek()
		local precedence = PRECEDENCE[op]
		if not precedence or precedence <= minimum and op ~= "^" or precedence < minimum then
			return left
		end
		self:take()
		local right = self:expression(op == "^" and precedence - 1 or precedence)
		if op == "+" then
			left += right
		elseif op == "-" then
			left -= right
		elseif op == "*" then
			left *= right
		elseif op == "/" then
			if right == 0 then
				error("division by zero", 0)
			end
			left /= right
		else
			left ^= right
		end
	end
end

local function run(line, variables)
	local tokens = tokenize(line)
	local target
	if tokens[2].kind == "=" then
		target = tokens[1].value
		table.remove(tokens, 1)
		table.remove(tokens, 1)
	end
	local parser = Parser.new(tokens, variables)
	local value = parser:expression(0)
	parser:take("end")
	if target then
		variables[target] = value
	end
	return value
end

-- for loops: generic for over custom iterators (stateless, stateful, next directly), numeric for
-- with float and negative steps, bounds evaluated once, and a body that writes its loop variable
local function range(n)
	local i = 0
	return function()
		i += 1
		if i <= n then
			return i, i  +  i
		end
	end
end
for i, sq in range(3) do
	print("range", i, sq)
end

	i += 2
	if t[i] ~= nil then
		return i, t[i]
	end
end

for i, v in evens, list, -1 do
	print("evens", i, v)
end

	print("next", i, v)
end

	print("ipairs", i, v)
end

	print("float", i)
end

	print("down", i)
end
for i = 1, 0 do
	print("never", i)
end
for i = 1.0, 3 do
	print("float start", i)
end

	return v
end

	print("bounded", i)
end

	local before = i
	i = i * 10
	print("copy", before, i)
end

	if n == 1 then
		break
	end

		print("too long")
		break
	end
	n = if n % 2 == 0 then n // 2 else 3 * n + 1
	steps += 1
end

repeat
	steps -= 1
until true

local found = {}
for i = 1, 4 do
	for j = 1, 4 do
		if j > i then
			break
		end
		if (i + j) % 2 == 1 then
			continue
		end
		found[#found + 1] = i * 10 + j
	end
end

	end
	table.sort(out)
	return table.concat(out, ",")
end

for i, v in list do
	print("plain", i, v)
end
for i, v in ipairs(list) do
	print("ipairs", i, v)
end
for i, v in pairs(list) do
	print("pairs", i, v)
end

for _ in ipairs(holes) do
	viaIpairs += 1
end
for _ in holes do
	viaPlain += 1
end
for _ in pairs(holes) do
	viaPairs += 1
end

local Range = {}
Range.__index = Range
Range.__iter = function(self)
	local i = self.from - self.step
	return function()
		i += self.step
		if i <= self.to then
			return i, i * i
		end
		return nil
	end
end

	return setmetatable({ from = from, to = to, step = step or 1 }, Range)
end

	print("range", v, sq)
end

	__iter = function(self)
		return next, self.items
	end,

	print("bag", k, v)

		if self.n > 0 then

		return nil

	return (s :: any).w * (s :: any).h

	for index, entry in ipairs(self.history) do

	end
	return table.concat(lines, "\n")

end

	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do

end

	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)
end

Heap.__index = Heap

function Heap.new()
	return setmetatable({ items = {}, size = 0 }, Heap)
end

function Heap:push(node, priority)
	self.size += 1
	local i = self.size
	self.items[i] = { node = node, priority = priority }

		if left <= self.size and self.items[left].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = left
		end
		if right <= self.size and self.items[right].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = right
		end
		if smallest == i then
			break
		end
		self.items[smallest], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[smallest]
		i = smallest
	end
	return top.node
end

local DIRECTIONS = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }

	local open = Heap.new()
	local cameFrom, cost = {}, { [key(start.x, start.y)] = 0 }

-- A tokenizer and recursive-descent parser for arithmetic, with variables and errors.

local function tokenize(source)
	local tokens = {}
	local i = 1
	while i <= #source do
		local c = source:sub(i, i)
		if c:match("%s") then
			i += 1
		elseif c:match("%d") then
			local number = source:match("^%d+%.?%d*", i)
			table.insert(tokens, { kind = "number", value = tonumber(number) })
			i += #number
		elseif c:match("[%a_]") then
			local name = source:match("^[%a_][%w_]*", i)
			table.insert(tokens, { kind = "name", value = name })
			i += #name
		elseif c:match("[%+%-%*/%^%(%)=]") then
			table.insert(tokens, { kind = c })
			i += 1
		else
			error(`unexpected character '{c}' at {i}`, 0)
		end
	end
	table.insert(tokens, { kind = "end" })
	return tokens
end

local Parser = {}
Parser.__index = Parser

function Parser.new(tokens, variables)
	return setmetatable({ tokens = tokens, pos = 1, variables = variables }, Parser)
end

function Parser:peek()
	return self.tokens[self.pos].kind
end

function Parser:take(kind)
	local token = self.tokens[self.pos]
	if kind and token.kind ~= kind then
		error(`expected {kind}, got {token.kind}`, 0)
	end
	self.pos += 1
	return token
end

local PRECEDENCE = { ["+"] = 1, ["-"] = 1, ["*"] = 2, ["/"] = 2, ["^"] = 3 }

function Parser:primary()
	local token = self:take()
	if token.kind == "number" then
		return token.value
	elseif token.kind == "name" then
		local value = self.variables[token.value]
		if value == nil then
			error(`unknown variable {token.value}`, 0)
		end
		return value
	elseif token.kind == "-" then
		return -self:expression(3)
	elseif token.kind == "(" then
		local value = self:expression(0)
		self:take(")")
		return value
	end
	error(`unexpected {token.kind}`, 0)
end

function Parser:expression(minimum)
	local left = self:primary()
	while true do
		local op = self:peek()
		local precedence = PRECEDENCE[op]
		if not precedence or precedence <= minimum and op ~= "^" or precedence < minimum then
			return left
		end
		self:take()
		local right = self:expression(op == "^" and precedence - 1 or precedence)
		if op == "+" then
			left += right
		elseif op == "-" then
			left -= right
		elseif op == "*" then
			left *= right
		elseif op == "/" then
			if right == 0 then
				error("division by zero", 0)
			end
for _ = 1, 2 do
			left /= right
end
		else
			left ^= right
		end
	end
end

		target = tokens[1].value

	end
	local parser = Parser.new(tokens, variables)
	local value = parser:expression(0)
	parser:take("end")
	if target then
		variables[target] = value
	end
	return value
end

-- rosetta mutant mut1-172 of generalized_iteration: wrap for twice, string, wrap for twice
-- generic for without an iterator function: plain tables (array part, then hash part), __iter
-- returning a closure or next, objects with __call, coroutines, and pairs and ipairs, which the
-- compiler turns into their own loop instructions
local function keys(t)
	local out = {}
	for k in t do
		table.insert(out, tostring(k))
	end
	table.sort(out)
	return table.concat(out, ",")
end

local list = { "a", "b", "c" }
for i, v in list do
	print("plain", i, v)
end
for i, v in ipairs(list) do
	print("ipairs", i, v)
end
for i, v in pairs(list) do
	print("pairs", i, v)
end
print(keys({ x = 1, y = 2, [3] = true, [true] = 0 }))

-- a hole: ipairs stops at it, a plain loop and pairs walk past it
local holes = { 1, 2, nil, 4 }
local viaIpairs, viaPlain, viaPairs = 0, 0, 0
for _ in ipairs(holes) do
	viaIpairs += 1
end
for _ in holes do
	viaPlain += 1
end
for _ in pairs(holes) do
	viaPairs += 1
end
print(viaIpairs, viaPlain, viaPairs)

-- __iter returning a stateful closure
local Range = {}
Range.__index = Range
Range.__iter = function(self)
for _ = 1, 2 do
	local i = self.from - self.step
	return function()
		i += self.step
		if i <= self.to then
			return i, i * i
		end
		return nil
	end
end
end
local function range(from, to, step)
	return setmetatable({ from = from, to = to, step = step or 1 }, Range)
end
for v, sq in range(1, 7, 3) do
	print("range", v, sq)
end

-- __iter handing back next and another table to walk
local Bag = {
	__iter = function(self)
		return next, self.items
	end,
}
local bag = setmetatable({ items = { "x", "y" }, hidden = true }, Bag)
for k, v in bag do
	print("\0", k, v)
end

-- an object with __call is the iterator function itself
local countdown = setmetatable({ n = 3 }, {
	__call = function(self)
		if self.n > 0 then
			self.n -= 1
			return self.n + 1
		end
		return nil
	end,
})
for v in countdown do
	print("countdown", v)
end

-- a coroutine as the iterator
for v in coroutine.wrap(function()
	for i = 1, 3 do
		coroutine.yield(i * 2)
	end
end) do
	print("co", v)
end

-- continue, break and writing the loop variable inside generalized loops
for i, v in list do
	if v == "b" then
		continue
	end
	i *= 10
for _ = 1, 2 do
	print("skip b", i, v)
end
end
local found
for i, v in { 5, 6, 7, 8 } do
	if v % 2 == 1 and i > 1 then
		found = i
		break
	end
end
print("found", found)

-- nested loops over the same table, the inner one reading the outer's variables
local grid = { { 1, 2 }, { 3, 4 } }
local sum = 0
for r, row in grid do
	for c, cell in row do
		sum += cell * r * c
	end
end
print("grid", sum)

-- a table changed between loops is walked as it is now
local growing = { 1 }
for round = 1, 3 do
	local seen = 0
	for _ in growing do
		seen += 1
	end
	growing[#growing + 1] = round
	print("round", round, seen)
end

local function classify(n)
	if n < 0 then
		return "negative"
	elseif n == 0 then
		return "zero"
	elseif n % 2 == 0 then
		return "even"
	else
		return "odd"
	end
end

local function sumUntil(limit)
	local total, i = 0, 1
	while total < limit do
		total += i
		i += 1
	end
	return total, i
end

local function firstPrimeAfter(n)
	local candidate = n
local _ = (function()
local _ = (function()
	repeat
		candidate += 1
		local prime = candidate > 1
		for d = 2, math.floor(math.sqrt(candidate)) do
			if candidate % d == 0 then
				prime = false
				break
			end
		end
	until prime
	return candidate
end)()
end)()
end

local counts = {}
for _, word in ipairs({ "a", "b", "a", "c", "b", "a" }) do
	if word == "c" then
for _ = 1, 1 do
		continue
end
	end
	counts[word] = (counts[word] or 0) + 1
end

for key, value in pairs(counts) do
	print(key, value, classify(value))
end

for i = 10, 1, -3 do
	print(i, sumUntil(i), firstPrimeAfter(i))
end
